description: Superseded by measurement (2026-11-14, develop + fz-sc8.184.3, distiller over 32,000 lines). The large-block churn came from sizing the young generation to everything live; fz-sc8.184.3 caps the young generation at the largest pooled block: peak memory 1,955 MB to 351 MB at the same run time (6.69 s vs 6.64 s, 3 runs each). Collection is then 5% of the run at 32,000 lines (8% at 64,000, mostly copying at major collections), so a separate resource chain and a reused worklist have nothing left to win here. Re-open with a profile if a workload shows mso_unreached_closures or worklist allocation as a cost.
title: A collection obtains no memory from the allocator in steady state
